questions.q: Psoriasis with thick crusts and cracks, worse in winter, and skin that cracks and bleeds, suggests:
questions.why: Topic 7, Practice of Medicine. Petroleum: winter aggravation, deep cracks.

questions.q: Antidiuretic hormone and oxytocin are synthesised in the:
opts: supraoptic and paraventricular nuclei of the hypothalamus
questions.why: They are made in hypothalamic neurons, carried down their axons and stored in and released from the posterior pituitary.

questions.q: The blood-brain barrier is formed mainly by:
opts: tight junctions of capillary endothelium in the brain
questions.why: Topic 5, Anatomy and Physiology. Supported by astrocyte foot processes.
Topic 6, Pathology, Microbiology and Diagnostics. Wet gangrene involves venous congestion and infection.

questions.q: A hypothyroid woman with a firm, painless goitre and strongly positive anti-thyroid peroxidase antibodies most likely has:
questions.why: Hashimoto's autoimmune thyroiditis, with anti-TPO antibodies, is the commonest cause of hypothyroidism in iodine-sufficient areas.

questions.q: Which of these is a feature of LIFE-THREATENING acute asthma?
questions.why: A silent chest, cyanosis, SpO2 below 92%, PEF below 33% and exhaustion mark life-threatening asthma; HR 110 and RR 25 mark acute severe asthma.

questions.q: Deep depression with suicidal thoughts, mental dullness and destructive impulses are the mental features of which miasm?
questions.why: The syphilitic miasm is destructive both in tissue and mind: depression, dullness, suicidal and destructive tendencies.

questions.q: Camphor is known in homoeopathy as an antidote to:

questions.why: Topic 5, Anatomy and Physiology. It mainly reflects conduction delay in the AV node.
